title: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22507v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Command-line interface (CLI) agents increasingly execute longer-horizon tasks, yet existing benchmarks either assume that user instructions remain fixed throughout execution or evaluate task outcomes without capturing runtime collaboration quality. In this paper, we present REALCLI, a paired benchmark that unifies the evaluation of task execution and human-agent collaboration quality on realistic CLI tasks. To comprehensively measure collaboration, REALCLI builds a five-dimensional framework, operationalized into 22 sub-dimensions and 51 interaction scenario templates. REALCLI provides two modes for paired comparison: REALCLI-EXEC supplies complete specifications upfront, whereas REALCLI-COLLAB introduces a scripted user that delivers progressive information, corrections, constraint revisions, and authorization decisions. translated_title: RealCLI：迈向CLI智能体人机协作的统一评估
translated_abstract: 命令行界面（CLI）智能体越来越多地执行长时程任务，然而现有的基准测试要么假设用户指令在整个执行过程中保持固定不变，要么在评估任务结果时未能捕捉运行时的协作质量。在本文中，我们提出了REALCLI，这是一个配对基准，用于在真实的CLI任务上统一评估任务执行和人机协作质量。为了全面衡量协作水平，REALCLI构建了一个五维评估框架，并将其具体化为22个子维度和51个交互场景模板。REALCLI提供两种模式用于配对比较：REALCLI-EXEC预先提供完整的规格说明，而REALCLI-COLLAB则引入一个脚本化的用户，该用户会逐步提供信息、更正、约束修订和授权决策。评估结果显示前沿智能体存在巨大的能力差距：最佳配置的平均得分仅为……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: REALCLI是一个统一评估CLI智能体任务执行与人机协作质量的配对基准，其通过包含22个子维度和51个交互场景模板的五维框架，以及完整规格说明（REALCLI-EXEC）与脚本化用户渐进交互（REALCLI-COLLAB）的双模式设计，揭示了前沿智能体在协作能力上的显著差距。
en_tdlr: REALCLI is a paired benchmark that unifies the evaluation of task execution and human-agent collaboration quality for CLI agents, featuring a five-dimensional framework with 22 sub-dimensions and 51 interaction scenario templates, along with dual modes—complete upfront specifications (REALCLI-EXEC) versus progressive interaction with a scripted user (REALCLI-COLLAB)—revealing profound capability gaps in frontier agents.
